en.manifest.name: PagerDuty
en.manifest.description: Verified PagerDuty incident webhooks, incident actions, and an on-call responder Bot that triages incidents and posts findings back as notes.
en.approval.postNote.title: Post triage note to incident {incidentId}?
en.approval.postNote.message: The note was drafted by the on-call responder character from read-only evidence. Approving authorizes exactly this incident note through the PagerDuty account.

zh-CN.manifest.name: PagerDuty
zh-CN.manifest.description: 经过验证的 PagerDuty 事件 Webhook、事件操作，以及一个值班响应机器人：分诊事件并把结论作为备注回写。
zh-CN.approval.postNote.title: 要将分诊备注发布到事件 {incidentId} 吗？
zh-CN.approval.postNote.message: 此备注由值班响应角色根据只读证据起草。批准后，将仅通过该 PagerDuty 账户发布这一条事件备注。
